test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If all the numbers are dropped from the given arrangement, which of the following will be the ninth to the left of S?

2 R Q 4 A 5 S I ^ 9 R # E % 8 S * P
solution:
Given series: Left side 2 R Q 4 A 5 S I ^ 9 R # E % 8 S * P Right side

If all the numbers from the given arrangement are dropped out, the new series will be as follows:

Left side** R Q A S I ^ R # E % S * P **Right side** **

Hence, the 9th element to the left of S is **Q**.
